note_en: A 比 B 还要… pushes an ordinary comparison further: not just "A is bigger than B" but "A is even bigger than B," with a hint that it went beyond expectations: 坝体比她在课本照片里看到的还要高大 "the dam was even more massive than in the photo in her textbook." 更 is more neutral and common in judgments: 这篇比你以前写的任何一篇都更打动人 "this one is more moving than anything you've written before."
